name: my-project
description: Code Agent - AI coding assistant desktop app
author: Code Agent

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev" "npm run server:watch"
scripts.server:watch: nodemon --watch server --ext js,json --ignore server/data --ignore server/node_modules server/index.js
scripts.electron:build: electron-vite build && npm run server:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build:win: electron-vite build && npm run server:build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build:mac: electron-vite build && npm run server:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
